params.description: The optional greater than or equal to timestamp to filter the logs.

params.name: timeLessThanOrEqualTo
params.description: The optional less than or equal to timestamp to filter the logs.

params.name: levelFilter
params.description: The optional parameter to filter the alert logs by log level.

params.name: groupBy
params.description: The optional parameter used to group different alert logs.

params.name: typeFilter
params.description: The optional parameter to filter the attention or alert logs by type.

params.name: logSearchText
params.description: The optional query parameter to filter the attention or alert logs by search text.

params.name: isRegularExpression
params.description: The flag to indicate whether the search text is regular expression or not.

params.name: page
params.description:
The page token representing the page from where the next set of paginated results
are retrieved. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records returned in the paginated response.
